latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – generate videos from text or images using a free, open-source cloud service.

- Converts text prompts or images into ready-to-share 1080p MP4 videos (up to 200MB per file).
- Supports direct upload, text-to-video, audio/BGM, text overlays, batch processing, and timeline editing.
- Anonymous use: automatic token management (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Real-time session handling with session state, credits check, export, and download capabilities.
- Full support for common video and image formats: MP4, PNG, JPG, WebM, GIF, etc.
- Error handling for expired tokens, file size/type restrictions, and rate limits.
